audit_metadata.title: Phase 34B Dataset Quality Audit and Leakage Forensics
audit_metadata.phase: Phase 34B — Dataset Quality Audit, Leakage Forensics, and Signer-Level Split Freeze

phase34a_collection_workflow_integrity.evidence: Signer authorization, 26x3x3 matrix, take-specific supersession, session recovery, and dHash duplicate filtering verified via automated tests.

phase34a_physical_collection_status.evidence: 0 of 6 planned development signers collected. 0 of 1,404 planned takes collected. Status for signer_06 through signer_11 is NOT_COLLECTED.

signer01_train_val_leakage.evidence: Train and validation splits share 4 of 5 sessions; 19 of 26 classes share the same session; 98.9% of val frames are within 5 seconds of a train frame (median: 2.0s); sequential filenames interleave across train and val.

signer01_validation_trustworthiness.evidence: Within-signer historical metrics on signer_01 evaluate frame interpolation rather than generalization. Independent validation performance cannot be inferred from historical signer_01 splits.

signer_partition_isolation.evidence: Backend fail-closed safeguards active. Zero sample or recording leakage between dev_train, dev_val, external_holdout, and frozen_benchmark.

capture_condition_metadata.evidence: Condition 2 conflates 15° lateral yaw (diagonal_15deg) with 30° downward camera pitch. Condition 3 distance (1.0m-1.2m) is nominal and operator-reported rather than instrument-verified.

quality_gates_on_real_data.evidence: Condition 3 challenge has zero human recordings. Hand bounding-box ratio check is configured as an attribute but not actively enforced as a frame rejection gate.

protected_assets_and_defaults.evidence: All 4 authoritative hashes match bit-for-bit. Production defaults remain yolo, standard, cpu, native, smoothing disabled, shadow disabled.

signer01_leakage_forensics_detail.recommendation: Do not use historical signer_01 train/val split for within-signer validation. Restrict signer_01 to training-only pool, or recollect multi-take session-disjoint signer_01 data.

condition_2.audit_note: AMBIGUITY: 15° represents horizontal yaw in legacy schema, while 30° represents downward vertical pitch of laptop camera. Recommend schema extension with explicit camera_yaw_deg and camera_pitch_deg.

condition_3.audit_note: Distance is operator-reported/nominal. Real low-light capture unvalidated on human participants.

hard_rejection_gates: Exact SHA-256 duplicate frame match (marked unusable)
Perceptual dHash static duplicate on consecutive frames with movement < 0.2 (marked unusable)
Static frame with pixel movement < 0.1 (marked unusable)
Zero hands detected after lap hand suppression (marked unusable)
warning_only_gates: Frame rate below 25.0 FPS (warning recorded in staging_info)
unimplemented_gates: Bounding box area ratio >= 0.02 (configured as self.min_hand_bbox_ratio but not actively enforced as a frame rejection filter in stage_recording)
